weekly_mastery.policy: A weekly mastery check must reflect the stated weekly focus and may not be satisfied by a recycled generic unit-domain quiz.

unit_mastery.purpose: Cumulative unit evidence combining broad definitive-answer coverage with written reflection/reasoning evidence.

assessment_policy.public_purpose: Practice, correction, retesting, progress evidence, and parent/administrator-reviewed portfolio evidence.
assessment_policy.secure_purpose: Separately issued summative testing when confidential administration is required.
assessment_policy.record_guidance: Browser-local scores and evaluator entries are editable and are not authoritative, confidential, digitally signed, or independently authenticated. The parent, teacher, or program administrator determines the official course grade and any credit awarded from retained evidence.

cumulative_scoring.rationale: Auto-scored correctness and human-reviewed mathematical reasoning are reported separately so selected-response recognition alone cannot certify full cumulative mastery.

secure_release_policy.midterm: A confidential Midterm v2 must use newly authored questions and a separately held answer key. Previously public questions are not eligible for confidential reuse.
secure_release_policy.final: A confidential Final v2 must use newly authored questions and a separately held answer key. Previously public questions are not eligible for confidential reuse.
secure_release_policy.public_repository_rule: Confidential answer keys and signing material must not be stored in this learner-facing repository.

definitive_answer_policy: Exactly one correct answer per auto-scored item
No subjective best-answer items without a defined criterion
Answer-choice presentation is designed to discourage pattern guessing
constructed_response_policy: Require visible mathematical reasoning rather than answer-only responses
Expect units, representations, verification, and interpretation when relevant
Use the shared 0-4 rubric for local evaluator review
Do not mark full cumulative mastery until evaluator review is complete
Retain the written response with the exported assessment result when used as portfolio evidence
